intended_use: AI-generated backgrounds on slides 2–7 and illustrative quiet/busy street scenes on slide 2. Actual counts and timelines are separate native evidence objects.

jobs.slide_title: One window shows how estimates can differ
jobs.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: optional illustrative image for a Duke statistics class slide. Generate a new fictional London-inspired scene. Do not reproduce an existing photograph or the actual experiment footage. No readable text, digits, logos, watermarks, charts, captions, interfaces or timestamp overlays. No identifiable faces. Natural anatomy, plausible road geometry, professional editorial photography. This is illustration only, never evidence of observed counts.
Primary request: A candid editorial street photograph of a burst of pedestrians crossing a traditional London zebra crossing together, with a noticeably quiet stretch of road extending behind them. A leafy residential London street, brick buildings, overcast daylight, authentic British road markings, natural walking poses. Capture a transient cluster, without implying any exact count. Eye-level wide documentary composition, no identifiable close-up faces.
Landscape 3:2 composition, high resolution, realistic color and texture. Keep the main subject readable when used as a modest inset in a blue-and-white presentation. Generate one individual image, not a collage.
